title: 5 Ways to Style a Sheer Embroidered Kurti
excerpt: From college to festive days: five easy ways to wear a sheer embroidered kurti, plus simple care tips.
body:
Sheer embroidered kurtis are one of the easiest ways to look put-together without trying too hard. The lined top keeps it comfortable, the sheer lower panel keeps it light, and the thread embroidery adds just enough detail. Here are five easy ways to wear one.

## 1. With straight jeans for college or a day out

The simplest look. Pair the kurti with dark blue straight or skinny jeans, add flat sandals or clear block heels, and you are ready. Tie the side cords a little tighter for a neater shape.

## 2. With a white palazzo for festive days

Swap the jeans for a flowy white or cream palazzo. Add silver jhumkas and a small potli bag and the same kurti is ready for a puja, a family dinner or a mehendi.

## 3. With a matching inner for office

If you want less sheer, wear a slim inner or slip in the same colour. Add straight trousers, a watch and simple studs. It looks polished in meetings and stays cool through the day.

## 4. With oxidised jewellery for a Jaipur look

Oxidised silver earrings and a stack of bangles go beautifully with white embroidery on **rani pink**, **bottle green** or **peach**. Keep the rest of the outfit simple and let the jewellery talk.

## 5. Layered with a dupatta for winter evenings

Throw on a soft printed dupatta or a light shawl. The colours of the kurti work with block prints and bandhani, so this is an easy way to reuse dupattas you already own.

## Quick care tips

- Hand wash or gentle machine wash in cold water
- Wash dark colours separately the first time
- Dry in shade and iron on low heat from the inside
